name: Necromantic Teachings
body:
You have broadened your study of necromantic spells.

Prerequisites: 4th-level necromancer.

Benefit: Choose one.

You gain access to and can learn the spells granted by another necromantic study of your choice, and you add one spell known from any of your necromantic studies‘ spell lists. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level you can cast.
You add two spells known from any of your necromantic studies‘ spell lists. These spells must be at least one level below the highest spell level you can cast.

Special: You can select this feat more than once.
